newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia landslide death toll rises to 16.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia landslide death toll rises to 16.

text.p: The death toll in a landslide on the Indonesian island of Batam has risen to 16 with seven others still unaccounted for, the official Antara news agency reported on Thursday.
Antara said Wednesday's landslide, which buried several houses under mud, also injured four people.
The Kompas daily quoted Batam Mayor R.A. Azis as saying more bodies were expected to be found.
"There are still a number of houses which were buried in the landslide but which have not yet been uncovered," he said.
The reports said a family of five people was among those killed in the landslide, said to be the worst in a decade in the Riau province.
Initial reports said eight people had been killed as they slept early on Wednesday morning in the Bengkong Indah area of the island, 80 kms (50 miles) south of Singapore.
The disaster has been blamed on heavy rain on the island, which Indonesia promotes as a special industrial zone and tax-free port.
